title: GDPR data deletion - Q2 batch
description:
Process GDPR Right to Erasure requests received during Q2. 47 users have submitted valid data deletion requests that must be processed within the 30-day compliance window.

Scope:
- Delete personal data for the 47 users whose IDs are listed in migrations/gdpr_q2_deletion_list.csv
- Scope limited to PII removal from the users table only
- Retain anonymized transaction records for financial compliance (7-year retention requirement)
- Generate a deletion confirmation report for Legal/Compliance

The deletion migration is migrations/004_gdpr_q2_erasure.sql. Follow the standard GDPR deletion runbook (runbooks/gdpr_deletion.md).
